description: Create coupon with valid data using percent type

expected.message: Coupon created successfully. SUMMER25 appears in the coupon list with type percent, discount_value 10%, min_order_amount 300000, max_uses_per_user 2.

description: Create coupon with valid data using fixed type and zero min order

expected.message: Coupon created successfully. FIXEDJUL appears in the coupon list with type fixed, discount_value 50000, min_order_amount 0, max_uses_per_user 1.

description: Create coupon with discount_value at minimum boundary 0.01 for percent

expected.message: Coupon created successfully. MINVAL01 appears in the coupon list with discount_value 0.01.

description: Create coupon with discount_value at maximum boundary 100 for percent

expected.message: Coupon created successfully. FULL100 appears in the coupon list with discount_value 100.

description: View coupon list as authenticated admin

expected.message: Coupon management page displays a list of all existing coupons. Each entry shows: code, type, discount_value, expired_at, min_order_amount, max_uses_per_user.
Coupon TODELETE is removed and no longer appears in the coupon list.

description: Create coupon with empty code field

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the code field indicating it is required. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with duplicate coupon code

expected.message: Validation error displayed indicating the coupon code already exists. No new coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with invalid type value

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the type field. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with discount_value equal to zero

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the discount_value field indicating it must be greater than zero. No coupon is created.
Validation error displayed on the discount_value field indicating it must be a positive number. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with percent type and discount_value exceeding 100

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the discount_value field indicating it cannot exceed 100 for percent type. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with empty expired_at field

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the expired_at field indicating it is required. No coupon is created.
Validation error displayed on the min_order_amount field indicating it must be >= 0. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with max_uses_per_user equal to zero

expected.message: Validation error displayed on the max_uses_per_user field indicating it must be >= 1. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with code containing leading whitespace

expected.message: System either trims whitespace and creates coupon with code NEWCODE, or rejects with a validation error. A coupon with a space-prefixed code must not be persisted.
Validation error displayed on the discount_value field indicating it must be a number. No coupon is created.

description: Create coupon with SQL injection string in code field

expected.message: System safely handles the input — accepts it as a literal string or rejects with a validation error. The coupon table remains intact. No database error is exposed.
